interpretation: Current exact key presence in the raw profile is necessary, but optimized !prof metadata and indirect target promotion must also be verified before calling a profile accepted.
Raw CFG counter vectors and LLVM function_entry_count have different meanings; the raw selected notify block vector is not its call count.

The diagnostic inherited-profile inline-Clone trial eliminated the native clone boundary and restored boxed conversion parity, but lost unrelated profile identities. It is not final acceptance evidence.
Both ConvertFn and nested BorrowedConversion clone boundaries must be checked in the optimized Base and final native path; an inline attribute alone is not evidence of inlining.

steps: Run llvm-profdata show --counts --ic-targets --function=<symbol> <profile> for each selected symbol. The six selected exact root keys use cgu.14.
Locate real archive members using llvm-ar t and llvm-nm --print-file-name; extract only selected bitcode members with llvm-ar p, then llvm-dis.
Resolve !prof and !PGOFuncName on root notify and virtual handlers; inspect hash_one for calls or alloca, and conversion wrappers for ConvertFn or BorrowedConversion clone calls.

Inspect the retained final FatLTO object with llvm-nm and targeted llvm-objdump --disassemble-symbols --reloc. Verify both public lookup routes inline pair hashing and boxed conversion has no nested or outer clone boundary.
Verify binary, native capture, fixture source, profile and Base hashes against the exact final fixture manifest before interpreting native evidence.
